main.description: Returns the current indexed attachment at the given AT-URI with its publisher view. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the attachment record, using a DID authority; lookup is by URI only, not a specific CID/version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify an attachment record.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed attachment was found at this AT-URI.

errors.name: AttachmentQueryFailed
errors.description: The attachment lookup or required publisher hydration failed.

attachmentView.description: Attachment with its hydrated publisher and unchanged source record; subject, content, and location references are not expanded, and external files are not fetched. Missing publisher sidecars are null; query or hydration failures fail the request.
